pillar_reactions.evidence: Understood and agreed without questions or elaboration: 'Yeah, that sounds good.' He had already sold himself on the modality before the call — 'I like the simplicity of it a lot... I don't remember ever ending up in a place where I don't have access to kettlebells' — so the pillar had nothing left to do.

'Yep. Yep.' when asked if the whole-foods and eating-window protocol made sense. He is already ahead of the pillar — near-zero processed food for 15 years and two documented six-month carnivore blocks — and had pre-emptively offered to follow whatever he was told: 'I'm interested in your guys' thoughts on that.'

The one pillar he pushed back on, and he redirected it: 'it's more the, it's more of the expert guidance. I think I could probably do it without as much accountability, but I really want to feel I'm more likely to do the thing. When I'm confident I'm doing it correctly.' He is buying technical instruction, not motivation — which matters, because form correction on an unrepaired labrum tear is a clinical judgement, not a coaching one.

anchors.competitor: Personal trainer, in-person, three days a week
anchors.note: The strongest supporting anchor in the batch. He paid $1,400/month for four months — $5,600 — for something that ended when he travelled. $6,000 for six months is a lower monthly rate than his existing reference price, and the rep drew the number out before presenting. It is the clearest reason the price landed with no resistance at all.

anchors.raw: it needs to be something different than. Needing $10,000 worth of gym equipment, because that's, it doesn't, it hasn't worked.
anchors.note: He had already rejected the equipment alternative himself on portability grounds before the call, so it never became a competing use of funds.

unmet_demand.want: Confirmation that a programme built on loaded ballistic kettlebell movement is appropriate for an unrepaired labrum tear currently under physical therapy
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Never raised by either party as a question to answer. There is no clinical screen, no contraindication guidance and no route for the coach to speak to a treating clinician. The prospect's own medical input covered dead hangs only.

unmet_demand.want: A programme that continues to work while he is away for a month or more at a time, which is what ended his last coaching arrangement
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Probably served — portability is the modality's main advantage and the rep touched it — but it was never explicitly addressed as the specific failure mode he named, and travel is the single thing that has broken every prior attempt.
